status: PROVISIONAL screening rules. General reference ranges for Nile tilapia culture, not validated for any specific tank, system, life stage or fish population, and not a trained or validated predictive model. Review with an aquaculture specialist before relying on them.

tilapia.label: Nile tilapia (general reference)
tilapia.lifeStageNote: Fry and fingerlings are generally more sensitive; thresholds here are not adjusted by life stage.

temperature.label: Temperature
check: Re-measure with a calibrated thermometer at several points and depths.
Check heaters, chillers, shading and inflow temperature.

warning: Watch the trend and re-measure at the next routine check.
high_concern: Investigate the heat or cooling source now and monitor fish behaviour closely.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: confirm the reading immediately and correct the temperature gradually (avoid abrupt changes).

pH.label: pH
check: Re-measure with a freshly calibrated pH meter (check buffers).
Check alkalinity, algae activity (daily pH swings) and source water.

warning: Re-measure and track the trend; look for the cause before adjusting.
high_concern: Identify the cause and plan a gradual correction; avoid sudden pH changes.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: confirm the reading and seek specialist advice before any correction.

dissolvedOxygen.label: Dissolved oxygen
check: Re-measure with a calibrated DO meter, ideally at several locations and near dawn.
Verify that aeration and circulation are running and unobstructed.

warning: Verify aeration and consider reducing feeding until oxygen is confirmed adequate.
high_concern: Increase aeration or circulation now and re-measure within the hour.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: restore oxygen immediately and watch the fish; confirm the reading with a second instrument.

turbidity.label: Turbidity
check: Re-measure (median of 3 readings is preferable) and inspect the water visually.
Check filtration, solids removal and feeding rate.

warning: Check filtration and solids removal at the next routine check.
high_concern: Inspect filters and feeding; high turbidity also degrades video analysis.
critical_concern: Investigate the source of suspended solids promptly.

unionizedAmmonia.label: Un-ionized ammonia (calculated)
unionizedAmmonia.derived: Calculated from total ammonia, pH and temperature of the SAME reading (Emerson et al. 1975 equilibrium).
check: Re-test total ammonia (note the method) together with pH and temperature.
Check biofilter function, feeding rate and stocking density.

warning: Re-test and review feeding and biofilter performance.
high_concern: Reduce feeding and check the biofilter; re-test within hours.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: confirm with a second test and seek specialist advice on water exchange; do not dose chemicals on a single reading.

nitrite.label: Nitrite
check: Re-test and note the method and units.
Check biofilter maturity and recent changes (new stock, medication, filter cleaning).

high_concern: Reduce feeding and check the biofilter; re-test within hours.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: confirm the result and seek specialist advice.

nitrate.label: Nitrate
check: Re-test; nitrate accumulates slowly and is usually managed by water exchange or plants.

warning: Plan routine water exchange or review nitrate removal.

salinity.label: Salinity
check: Re-measure with a calibrated refractometer or conductivity meter.
Check the water source and evaporation.

warning: Confirm the salinity is intended for this culture.
high_concern: Investigate the source and avoid abrupt changes.
critical_concern: Treat as urgent: confirm the reading and seek specialist advice.
